claims.evidence: Witness report only shows a portable blue metal gas burner/stand assembly; no clear evidence of an industrial cooker (e.g., full cooker body, multiple burners, oven) and no brand/model details.

risks.risk: Not complete or missing key parts (regulator, hose, knobs/burner cap) which affects usability and safety.
risks.proof: A photo/clip showing the full set laid out (burner, knobs, burner cap/grate, regulator, hose) with close-ups of connection ends.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as incomplete/unknown working condition (assume may require missing parts).

risks.risk: Does not light properly or weak flame due to valve/igniter/burner wear.
risks.proof: A short video clip of lighting the burner and showing steady flame for at least 30–60 seconds.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not working/untested until it demonstrates a strong, steady flame.

risks.risk: Gas hose/regulator condition and potential leaks.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of hose and regulator fittings plus a leak test clip (e.g., soapy water bubbles at joints while pressurized).
risks.if_unproven: Priced with safety risk assumed (as-is, may need replacement of hose/regulator).

risks.risk: Physical condition issues (rust, dents, warped burner ring/grates) that reduce performance and increase replacement cost.
risks.proof: Clear close-up photos of the burner ring/grates and legs showing rust level, dents, and whether the ring sits flat.
risks.if_unproven: Priced at worst visible condition (as-is with possible rust/warping).

risks.risk: Fitment/compatibility with standard LPG cylinders (size/dimensions, connection type).
risks.proof: A photo with a measuring tape and a clip showing the connection to a standard cylinder/regulator type.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially requiring adapter/compatibility check.

proof_requests: Send a video of the burner being lit (steady flame) and turning off/on.
Show close-ups of the valve/igniter area (if any) and the burner cap/grate seating.
Confirm whether regulator and hose are included; upload photos of them and the connection ends.
Provide a leak-test clip at the joints (soapy water bubbles) while pressurized.
Upload clear photos of rust/dents/warping on the burner ring and legs, plus overall dimensions.
response.reason: The witness can identify the item type as a portable gas burner/stand, so it can be priced at its worst-case as an untested, possibly incomplete and potentially unsafe unit until it proves lighting performance and safe connections.
